words.description: What the tutor says to the child: shown on the screen and read aloud. Plain words he can hear; never the answer to his homework.

profile_update.description: What this turn taught you about him, in learn-kit's profile fields. Only what he said or showed in this talk.

guessed.description: The fields above you guessed from how he talks, rather than were told in so many words.

goal_suggestion.description: A goal to offer him, by the id of one of the request's goals, and why, in a few words.

world.description: The world to open now, when he chose one in this turn. Absent otherwise.

memory_update.description: What the talk should remember beyond its turns: facts to add or remove, and the summary so far.

form_values.description: When the request has `form`: the values this turn gives the form's fields, each a field by its name and the whole new value. Never a pictures field, and a choice only ever one of its options.

form_ask.description: When the request has `form`: the name of the field `words` asks about; absent when every required field holds something.
